offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures metal and plastic containers, closures and dispensing systems that food, beverage, personal care and household product companies use to package their goods. Products are made in plants across North America, Europe and Asia and sold directly to brand owners.

primary_products.value: metal food cans; aerosol cans; metal and plastic closures; plastic containers; dispensing pumps and sprayers

customer_segment.value: B2B: food and beverage makers, pet food producers, personal care and household product brand owners

end_markets.value: food; beverages; personal care; household products; pet food

revenue_model.value: product sales: containers, closures and dispensing systems sold to consumer goods manufacturers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes containers and closures from steel, aluminum and resin, sold to consumer goods brand owners

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, South America and Asia, with plants in the US, Canada, Mexico and several European and Asian countries

specialization.value: related lines: metal containers, closures, plastic containers and dispensing systems sold to the same consumer goods customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling directly to large food, beverage and consumer goods manufacturers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food contact safety rules from the FDA and EU regulators, plus environmental and workplace safety rules
